In this Statement of Work, INL - El Salvador is supporting the National Academy of Public Security (ANSP) in its efforts to modernize classrooms and offices used for videoconferences at the San Luis Talpa campus. The acquisition of monitors, cameras, large-format displays, scanning equipment, laptop computers, audio systems, wireless microphones, software, and related accessories addresses a capability gap in digital training and institutional coordination infrastructure. This project enhances virtual learning environments, improves operational readiness for remote and hybrid training activities, and builds sustainable capacity for more effective academy inst
